sections.bio:
Stephane Nembot is an AI Consultant, Scrum Master, and dynamic speaker on a mission to empower teams through AI, foster innovation through collaboration, and shape the future of technology through ethical leadership. Drawing from a rich background that spans tech, corporate innovation, agile coaching, and education, Stephane brings a unique blend of vision, discipline, and heart to every initiative he leads.
A former NFL athlete turned tech leader, he channels his high-performance mindset into guiding cross-functional teams through agile transformations, AI enablement, and digital innovation. With hands-on experience across the full software development lifecycle, Stephane is known for creating psychologically safe, collaborative environments that unlock team potential and deliver meaningful outcomes.
He specializes in corporate AI enablement—including prompt engineering, ChatGPT integration, and tool demonstrations—alongside expert facilitation of Scrum events and Agile training. Whether leading sprints, hosting workshops, or delivering keynote talks and podcasts, Stephane is committed to helping organizations harness the power of AI and agile practices to drive real change.
Rooted in values of honesty, loyalty, vision, and communication, Stephane continues to bridge strategy with execution—transforming uncertainty into opportunity, and teams into catalysts for innovation.
